notes: Source is the manufacturer's own RNHP User Guide (p/n 775-00024 Rev B), linked from the product page at https://rupertneve.com/products/rnhp, which includes an annotated front/back panel diagram confirming every physical connector. Desktop/VESA-mountable unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits is omitted. Input A is a stereo pair of combo jacks (XLR3 primary, accepts 1/4" TRS) calibrated for +4dBu balanced line level; Input B is a stereo pair of RCA jacks calibrated for -10dBV; Input C is a single 3.5mm stereo jack for mobile-device sources. Only one input is active at a time via the front-panel A/B/C selector switch (not a physical port). The single front-panel headphone output is a 1/4" (6.35mm) stereo TRS jack rated for 16-600 ohm headphones. Power is via an external 24VDC/0.25A (6W min) adapter into a rear-panel barrel-style DC jack; no internal AC power connector exists on the chassis itself. No bandwidth-graded connectors are present (pure analog audio device), so no "grade" fields apply.
